summary: Official Maharashtra and Gondia land-records pages establish a local cadastral/land-record custodian and Bhu-Naksha viewer lead. A bounded anonymous request did not verify a safe parcel ID plus full polygon response; no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Marathi discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-10115-gondia.json.
requestOutcomes: The official state portal and Gondia district land-records page were available as first-party evidence. The public Bhu-Naksha viewer route was identified, but a TLS-verified direct GET timed out after 20 seconds. No credentials, login, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS-disable action was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [21.4587657129893, 80.1948789301981] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
Local custody is evidenced for Gondia district and its taluka offices, but citywide open parcel coverage was not verified.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source schema or CRS was retrieved or retained.
A timeout, inaccessible viewer, map extent miss, login wall or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research bookkeeping only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial review remains required.
